title: Protein generation with evolutionary diffusion: sequence is all you need
layout_note: Four titled panels. A spans the top: left, a large dot-grid 'Sequence Design Space' on a pale blue-grey panel with callouts for the sequence and structure database sizes; right, curly braces around three rows sequence -> structure -> function feeding an EvoDiff network glyph, which outputs braces around three new sequences -> function icons. B (diffusion process: circled states with forward/backward arrow pairs, and two dashed boxes showing masked vs mutating corruption on letter strings) and C (unconditional generation: sequence and MSA grids at x_T, x_t, x_0) share the middle row. D across the bottom shows three conditional tasks separated by vertical rules, each as sequence/MSA grids above dashed boxes with the structure.
grouping: Dashed grey rounded boxes hold structures and corruption examples; curly braces group sets of sequences; bold panel titles. Colour encodes a residue's state with one code across B, C and D: grey for natural or context residues, orange for masked or corrupted ones, blue for generated ones, green for a fixed motif - also used on the structure renders in D (grey fold with blue generated or green motif segments).
shapes_depth: Sequences are rows of square cells; MSAs are grids whose top row (the query) is darker than the rows below; corruption is shown on letter strings with '#' masks and orange mutated letters. The model is a flat grey trapezoid with a small node-link network inside. Structures are flat cartoon renders inside dashed boxes; functions are line icons (pill, factory, wheat). Flat, no shadows.
proposed_highlight: EvoDiff is the one named model glyph (bold italic name over a trapezoid network icon) at the centre of panel A; its outputs are blue, the colour then used for every generated residue in C and D.
lesson: Make generated residues one colour (blue) everywhere - sequence rows, MSA grids and the cartoon under each task - and masked or corrupted residues another (orange), so conditional tasks such as inpainting and motif scaffolding read as which cells change colour.
notes: Venue = bioRxiv preprint: the PDF header reads 'this version posted September 12, 2023' (v1; venue_source: pdf); no journal version was checked. refs crop recorded only three small embedded images (in panel A; photo_share 0.007); the structure renders in panels A and D were not recorded as images and are measured as drawing.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: protein sequence generation with discrete diffusion (unconditional, inpainting, motif scaffolding)
taxonomy.note: architecture other = the denoiser is drawn only as a generic trapezoid network glyph (sequence CNN / MSA transformer not shown); paradigm D3PM = discrete denoising diffusion, alongside order-agnostic autoregressive diffusion (OADM); crop opened from the build cache at kb-build/protein-structure/crops/evodiff/fig1.png

insights.structure: Four lettered, titled panels: A across the top (Sequence Design Space dot-grid, then braces of natural sequences -> structure -> function feeding EvoDiff and out to new sequences -> function), B and C side by side in the middle, and D across the bottom split by vertical rules into three conditional tasks.
insights.data: Sequences are rows of square cells and MSAs are cell grids whose top query row is darker; corruption is shown on letter strings with '#' masks and orange mutated letters; structures are cartoon renders in dashed grey boxes; functions are line icons (pill, factory, wheat).
insights.emphasis: One residue colour code runs through B, C and D and onto the structure renders - grey context, orange masked/corrupted, blue generated, green fixed motif - so each task reads as which cells turn blue.
insights.flow: Each panel reads left-to-right (x_T -> x_t -> x_0, input -> generated), panels read A then B/C then D; B pairs forward 'Controlled corruption' and backward 'Neural network denoiser' arrows above the chain of circled states.
insights.avoid: The colour code is never keyed in the figure, and panel A's large dot-grid 'design space' and function icons spend space on motivation rather than method.

arrangement.units: four lettered panels titled in bold, unframed except panel A's pale grey design-space box and dashed boxes for corruption examples and structures; D holds three sub-panels separated by thin vertical rules
arrangement.inputs_as: cell rows for natural sequences and MSA grids, with letter strings in B
arrangement.shared: one residue colour code across B, C and D
